text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the 
academy――

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Wow, good timing! Hey, Trainer, could ya 
clap the beat for me?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'm just about to do a dance lesson. A 
simple four-count is totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyyyaaaahhh!!! Please wait! I really only 
wanted to 'experience' it for a second!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Having Tap-san personally teach me is far 
too gracious, I'm unworthy!! Doing it by 
myself is more than enough!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
No need to be so shy. Dancing is meant to 
be enjoyed with friends, right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I'm happy. That someone showed up 
who's interested in the dancing I love so 
much!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I'll teach ya as gently as I 
can. Alright Trainer, count us in!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...M-My beloved oshi-sama is going this 
far for someone like me...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Unworthy as I am, Agnes Digital will dance 
with all her might!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! Awesome! Let's crank up 
the hype even more!
Another day――

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Here. I commented on all the points you 
need to fix.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaahh!! I'll treat this as a family 
heirloom!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm really sorry. Making you look at 
code that screams total amateur, when I 
just wanted to 'experience' it...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It was just written so disgusting I 
couldn't stand looking at it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you're gonna keep doing it, fix your 
damn formatting to the bare minimum. And 
never let garbage code like that into my 
sight again.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Y-Y-Y-Yes, ma'am!! Digi-tan understands 
completely!
choice_data_list:
(Huh, so she's interested in programming 
too.)

text_block_list.text: Yet another day, while walking――
(*thump thump... roll roll...*)
choice_data_list:
Huh, a soccer ball? Where did that come 
from...?

text_block_list.text: ――Excuuuse me~! That's miiine!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyah~ thanks for picking it up! I was 
trying it out for practice, but I just 
can't seem to handle it well at all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes! Lately, I've wanted to 
'experience' things firsthand again!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I just get so curious, you know...? Like, 
what's it like to actually do it~? What 
kind of feelings does it bring~?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Is it soothing? Is it exhilarating? How 
long does it take to get good at it? 
Things like that!
choice_data_list:
Jumping right into trying it out is 
amazing...!

Jumping right into trying it out is 
amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No, no, no, not at all! I'm sorry, 
it's really nothing that impressive!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's really the people who already do 
these things who are incredible!

Watching Agnes Digital's humility made me 
all the more impressed by her.
